name: Sekolah Islam Annajah Jakarta
address: Jl. Ciledug Raya No.10, Pesanggrahan, Jakarta Selatan

notes.id: Play group/TK. Uang pangkal termasuk SPP Juli 2027, seragam 5 stel, buku & alat tulis 1 tahun, kegiatan 1 tahun (rekreasi, kunjungan edukasi, manasik haji & tes IQ untuk TK B), rapor, foto.
notes.en: Playgroup/kindergarten. Entry fee includes July 2027 tuition, 5 uniform sets, a year of books & stationery, a year of activities (trip, educational visits, mock hajj & IQ test for TK B), report book, photo.

source.title: PPDB Annajah Islamic Jakarta School TP 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

notes.id: Uang pangkal Rp23.800.000 (dari TK luar Annajah) / Rp17.850.000 (TK Annajah gelombang 1); termasuk SPP Juli 2027, gedung & seragam, buku 1 tahun, kesiswaan, ujian, rapor.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp23,800,000 (from outside kindergartens) / Rp17,850,000 (Annajah kindergarten, wave 1); includes July 2027 tuition, building & uniforms, a year of books, student affairs, exams, report book.

source.title: PPDB Annajah Islamic Jakarta School TP 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

notes.id: Uang pangkal Rp18.680.000 (dari SD/MI luar) / Rp14.010.000 (SDI Annajah); termasuk seragam 5 stel, SPP Juli 2027, ekskul non-mitra, buku 1 tahun, ulangan umum, LDKS/city tour, jaket almamater. Uang pangkal tidak dapat dikembalikan bila mengundurkan diri.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp18,680,000 (from other primary schools) / Rp14,010,000 (SDI Annajah); includes 5 uniform sets, July 2027 tuition, extracurriculars, a year of books, exams, leadership camp/city tour, school jacket. The entry fee is non-refundable if you withdraw.

source.title: PPDB Annajah Islamic Jakarta School TP 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

notes.id: Uang pangkal Rp18.985.000 (dari SMP/MTs luar) / Rp14.239.000 (MTs/SMP Annajah); termasuk seragam 6 stel, SPP Juli 2027, ekskul 1 tahun, buku kelas X, ujian, lab bahasa, program riset, LDKS. SPP Rp1.300.000 tidak naik selama 3 tahun, termasuk lab komputer & bahasa. Bayar minimal 50% setelah lulus seleksi, sisanya tahap II. Uang pangkal tidak dapat dikembalikan bila mengundurkan diri.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp18,985,000 (from other junior highs) / Rp14,239,000 (Annajah); includes 6 uniform sets, July 2027 tuition, a year of extracurriculars, grade 10 books, exams, language lab, research programme, leadership camp. Tuition Rp1,300,000 is fixed for 3 years and includes computer & language labs. Pay at least 50% after acceptance, the rest in stage II. The entry fee is non-refundable if you withdraw.

source.title: PPDB Annajah Islamic Jakarta School TP 2027/2028 (situs resmi)
